OUR STORY

A Mayville
original.

A historic address. A new reason to visit.

SINCE 1896

History you
can stay in.

Originally the Beaumont Hotel, the building was designed by Henry Messmer & Son for Jacob and Anna Mueller. It has been part of downtown Mayville since 1896.

Today, the Audubon Inn brings eighteen guest rooms, gathering space, and the Beaumont Bar together at 45 North Main Street.

1896

The Beaumont Hotel is built.

1988

Listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
